summary: Phase 3 revised scenario set for the sales-order ↔ manufacturing-order (SO↔MO) linkage contract — 31 scenarios across 6 risk categories. Revised to fix the critic's S04 picking-vs-cancel error (verified: pickManufacturingIngredientInTx at lib/inventory/kernel/operations/manufacturing.ts:319 DOES write inventoryEvents with eventType='manufacturing_ingredient_consumption' at lines 388 and 412, and the MO delete guard at queries.ts:6446-6500 checks eventType without subtype discrimination — so picks DO block delete and S04's premise stands). Adds S04b to exercise T18b (the worst-case CLAIM_FINALIZED_MO terminal-stuck path). Demotes S02 and S05 from P0 → P1; keeps S01/S03/S04/S04b/S11/S12 at P0. Moves S13 and S14 from fast → slow (multi-step setup). Adds positive control to S14. Pre-commits S15 to T24's modeled outcome (both POSTs return 201 with distinct MO ids) and pins the no-idempotency-claim invariant. S16 winner/loser identified by response shape via Promise.allSettled. S17 adds inventoryEvents/stockAllocations no-op negative assertion. S20 cites PUT /api/items/[id] as the BOM mutation path. Adds 11 challenge-driven scenarios: S21 bulk MO DELETE atomic-fail, S22 bulkConfirmSalesOrders dead-write contract pin, S23 BR-6 second branch cross-SO shared allocation, S24 cross-endpoint bulk-vs-single race, S25 item soft-delete when MO is cancelled (T26 + cancelled-MO inverse), S26 parallel PUT+DELETE on same MO, S27 PUT natural-idempotency, S28 moveReplacedSalesLineAllocationsInTx multi-line pairing, S29 BR-1 violation via PUT/edit-add-link (CONFIRMED PRODUCTION GAP — see notes_for_phase_4), S30 stale-form unsaved-changes (no create-time snapshot fallback). Strengthens S01 with exact expectedQty delta, S04 with the picks-do-write-consumption-events evidence pin, S10 with concrete inventory-effect assertions, S15 with set-equality assertion on response.id vs DB id. Lane split per CLAUDE.md (Playwright-only): 8 fast + 23 slow. Every audit-named gap (1–5) plus the 11 challenge critical_gaps maps to ≥1 scenario.

inferences.claim: Picking DOES write manufacturing_ingredient_consumption events. Verified by reading pickManufacturingIngredientInTx at lib/inventory/kernel/operations/manufacturing.ts:319 — it writes eventType='manufacturing_ingredient_consumption' at lines 388 and 412 (subtype 'manufacturing_pick'). The MO delete guard at queries.ts:6446-6500 filters by eventType only and does NOT discriminate by subtype. Therefore picks block MO delete. S04 retains its stuck-after-pick premise.

validateSalesLineLinkInTx is the only link guard reached by both create and update, and it has no existing_active_mo check anywhere in lines 729-819. Therefore PUTting a sales-link onto a previously-unlinked MO can claim a sales line already claimed by another active MO. BR-1's one-time-claim invariant is enforceable only by the bulk-from-SO preview (which filters out existing_active_mo lines); both single-create POST and edit-PUT bypass it. S29 will catch this code defect.

T18b (S04b) reaches MO_DONE; cancel blocks for a different reason (production output recorded) and SO delete is PERMANENTLY stuck. Both deserve coverage.

production_bug_discovery.title: BR-1 one-time-claim invariant is not enforced on the single-create POST or edit-PUT paths
production_bug_discovery.summary: validateSalesLineLinkInTx was the only link guard reached by both POST /api/manufacturing-orders and PUT /api/manufacturing-orders/[id]. It checked line.itemId === productId, line.orderStatus === 'open', line.deletedAt IS NULL — but did NOT query manufacturingOrders for an existing active claim. BR-1's one-time-claim invariant was enforced only by the bulk-from-SO preview filter at lib/manufacturing/sales-order-manufacturability.ts:222-235 (existing_active_mo). Therefore: (1) two parallel POSTs without Idempotency-Key could both 201 on the same sales line (S15 / T24); (2) a PUT could attach a sales-link onto a previously-unlinked MO and claim a line already claimed by another active MO (S29). Any user with module:manufacturing write could multiply-claim a sales line via the edit path.
production_bug_discovery.fix_applied: Added assertNoOtherActiveMoClaimsLineInTx helper called from both happy-path branches of validateSalesLineLinkInTx. The helper SELECTs manufacturingOrders WHERE salesOrderLineId = X AND deletedAt IS NULL (excluding the current MO id when passed). If any other active MO claims the line, throws ManufacturingError(409, 'Sales order line is already linked to manufacturing order …'). The PUT caller now passes the MO id so the function doesn't block self-rebinding.
production_bug_discovery.race_remaining: S15 (parallel POST without Idempotency-Key) is still test.fixme'd because the existing_active_mo check is not race-proof under READ COMMITTED isolation — two transactions can both pass the check before either inserts. A fully race-proof fix would need either a SELECT … FOR UPDATE on salesOrderLines or a partial unique index. The common case (sequential add-link) is now enforced; the rare-but-possible parallel race is documented for a follow-up.
